sections.title: AWS Services by Cloud Experts

sections.title: Why Choose the AWS Cloud Solution for Your Organization?
sections.intro: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is a popular cloud computing platform for organizations of all sizes: cloud infrastructure, cloud security, data analysis and backup, custom application development, and much more.

featured.title: Flexibility, security and scalability
featured.text: The AWS cloud computing platform offers organizations all the flexibility, security, accessibility and scalability they need to improve their operational performance. Our specialists have cutting-edge AWS expertise with Amazon EC2 (IaaS), Amazon Elastic Beanstalk (PaaS), and all AWS SaaS solutions.

aside.title: AWS Partnership
aside.text: Trust our team to ensure smooth, efficient migration of your applications to AWS.
